# Bitcoin Stratigraphy — Bitcoin Analytics, Proofs, and Agent Receipts

> Bitcoin Stratigraphy serves indexed Bitcoin telemetry and agent-oriented
> analytics, paid REST and MCP interfaces, cryptographic verification, and
> off-chain Bitcoin-tip receipts. Historical index data is not live-tip data or
> native per-record Bitcoin block provenance.

## Agent entry points
- [Interactive Developer Portal & Live Tool Explorer](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/docs): live schemas and a manual playground for 15 MCP tools across 4 namespaces, including OpenTimestamps notarization.
- [Python SDK and integration cookbooks](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/cookbooks): CrewAI, LangChain and AutoGen examples; [HTTPX Python SDK/client source](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/cookbooks/l402_client.py). Payments require explicit callbacks.
- [MCP auto-discovery manifest](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/.well-known/mcp.json): transport, documentation links, namespaces and pricing methods.
- [Complete tool schemas and TypeScript SDK usage](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/llms-full.txt)
- [MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/mcp): POST JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, starting with `tools/list`; this is a protocol endpoint, not a browsable HTML page.
- [Pre-flight price discovery](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/api/v1/cost): GET REST tiers; POST `{"tools":["stratigraphy.get_latest","proof.verify_zk_proof"]}` for itemized MCP prices. These selectors map to canonical `stratigraphy.get` and `proof.verify` for pricing only. Quotes create no invoices. Paid MCP credentials are tool-scoped: one call by default, or 100 calls with an explicit 100x-priced batch purchase.
- [Paid REST telemetry stream](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/api/v1/stratigraphy/stream): `GET` Server-Sent Events with a 30-second refresh interval. This is a separate REST transport, not MCP; consult `/api/v1/cost` for the current price and assets.
- [OpenAPI document](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Health](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/api/healthz)
- [Public Hugging Face JSONL dataset export](/api/export/huggingface): source-grounded instruction/response records; use `?format=json&limit=100` for a JSON array.
- [Machine-readable LLM schema manifest](/.well-known/llm-schema.json): export parameters, field definitions, domain constraints, and verification protocols.

## Access and settlement

Agents MUST use an L402-capable wrapper such as Lightning Labs `lnget` or
`lightning-enable-mcp` to settle paid MCP calls. See
[the canonical payment and sandbox guide](/.well-known/llms.txt).
Only `stratigraphy.list` (alias `stratigraphy.latest`) and `proof.list`
(alias `proof.status`) are free canonical tools. The remaining thirteen require
payment. For 100 calls to one paid tool, request its challenge with
`X-L402-Batch-Size: 100`, pay the 100x invoice once, and reuse that credential
within its expiry and quota. Delegation does not reset the quota.

Public metadata, health, MCP tool discovery, and the Hugging Face export need
no payment. Paid operations use endpoint-specific prices and return the
applicable challenge; query `/api/v1/cost` and use the actual challenge rather
than relying on a static price. The L402 router supports `btc-lightning`,
`l-btc`, and `taproot-assets` where available. MCP supports Lightning L402;
Base USDC x402 is conditional and only applies to MCP when explicitly reported
available. Do not infer Base USDC availability for REST or the SSE stream.

The SDK's REST client may use a REST-scoped subscription credential according
to its own path, request, and expiry restrictions. MCP credentials are scoped
to one operation: default credentials allow one call, while explicit batch
credentials allow 100 calls. Neither may cross tools or REST routes.

## Capabilities and trust boundaries

- `proof.attenuate` narrows an existing valid macaroon with enforced caveats,
  including TTL and request-count limits; it does not create a paid parent
  entitlement.
- Proof workflows include Groth16/Poseidon BN254 telemetry verification and a
  separate drift proof path. OpenTimestamps receipt verification is a distinct
  mode, not a telemetry proof or a Bitcoin-tip receipt.
- `proof.ground` issues off-chain Schnorr-signed Bitcoin-tip receipts for agent
  context or dataset CIDs. It does not broadcast a Bitcoin transaction.
- The Nostr NIP-01/78 mesh uses pinned reciprocal peers for signed broadcasts
  and quorum checks. Peer agreement is not source truth.

## Scope
Use `stratigraphy.get`/`stratigraphy.list` for the indexed telemetry dataset, `stratigraphy.get_digest` for token-optimized record summaries (record hash, not block hash or ZK proof), `stratigraphy.get_diff` to compare two indexed entries' target multipliers, dates, and derived height labels, and `stratigraphy.get_range` for bounded indexed records. Daily heights are deterministic dataset indexes, not observed per-record Bitcoin blocks or the live Bitcoin tip. Use `proof.attenuate` to derive narrower delegation macaroons from an authentic unexpired parent (no new invoice; the parent's payment proof remains necessary). Use `proof.verify`/`proof.submit` for Groth16 telemetry/drift proof workflows, `proof.get_by_hash`/`proof.list` for process-memory proof and attestation lookups (including context receipts indexed by `contextHash`), and `proof.ground` for off-chain Bitcoin-tip grounding of either agent context or a dataset CID. A signed dataset-tip receipt is not a ZK proof, proof of work, or on-chain commitment.
